name: Can I prevent future whole-house slow drains?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future whole-house slow drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future whole-house slow drains involves mindful usage and occasional maintenance. Avoid pouring grease down drains, dispose of hair and food scraps properly, and only flush toilet paper. Consider regular professional drain cleaning, especially if your home is older or has a history of blockages. For homes with nearby trees, periodic sewer line inspections can catch root intrusion early. Using drain screens can also significantly reduce debris entering your plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent slow drains by avoiding grease and hair down pipes, using drain screens, and flushing only toilet paper. Regular professional cleaning and sewer line inspections help, too.
